{{Top|leg}}
'''''Gloom Dweller''''' was the slang used to describe those inhabitants of the lower-levels of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
